title: Show the account greeting and avatar fallback
description: Adds a greeting helper for the account header and an avatar helper that falls back to the user's initials when they have not uploaded a picture.

expected.note: `profile` is typed `Profile | null` and `displayName` is optional, so this dereference throws for a logged-out visitor or a profile without a display name. Guard both: bail out (or use `formatName`) when `profile` or `profile.displayName` is missing.
The function declares a `string` return type but returns nothing when `imageUrl` is unset, so callers get `undefined`. It must return the initials-based fallback in that branch.
